page_title: AI Switcher Desktop: Account Switcher Download

summary.name: AI Switcher Desktop
summary.one_liner: A desktop app for switching between multiple accounts used by Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity CLI, with a visual interface on top of the aisw CLI runtime.
use_cases: switch between work and personal AI coding accounts
verify which account is active in a repository
inspect and recover account state without editing hidden files
manage Claude Code and Codex CLI logins from one window
summary.what_it_does: The desktop app shows the active identities for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity CLI in one place. Users can switch accounts deliberately, inspect drift between expected and active identities, and recover state without manually editing hidden files. It bundles the aisw v0.3.10 runtime and shares local profiles with the aisw CLI, so either can be used on the same accounts. The page describes the current release as v0.2.1 alpha, published September 11, 2026.
notable: Visual control surface over the aisw CLI, using the same local profiles
Installers for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel (DMG), Windows x64, and Linux x64 (AppImage, DEB, RPM)
Open source desktop repository with architecture notes on the native bridge
caveats: Early alpha release; the page warns users may encounter issues and asks for reports on GitHub
The aisw CLI is described as the more mature way to switch accounts
